arabic text: Abbas ke parcham ko hawa chum rahi hai
Lagata hai ke zehra ki duwa chum rahi\nhai
english translation text: (It seems that Zahra's)\nx2 prayer is kissing it

arabic text: aa dekh sukaina teri abbas ka lasha\n(Darya ke kinare pe qaza chum rahi hai)
english translation text: Come, Sakina, see the body of your Abbas\n(Death itself kisses him beside the river)

arabic text: Joo bhi juki jati hai khaza chu ke alam ko) \n(Jese ke ye zainab ki rida chum rahi hai)
english translation text: Every branch bows after touching the standard\n(As though Zainab's veil is kissing it)

arabic text: Sar apna patak ta hai kinaro pe ye paani\nYe arshe ko matam ki sada chum rahi hai
english translation text: The water beats its head upon the riverbanks\nThe cry of mourning kisses the Divine Throne

arabic text: Behta huwa pani hai ke abbas ke aansu\nmashkize ko umat ki jafa chum rahi hai
english translation text: Is this flowing water, or Abbas's tears?\nThe nation's cruelty kisses the water-skin

arabic text: Sar chum ke ghazi ka kaha ibne ali ne\nabbas kadam tere wafa chum rahi hai
english translation text: Kissing the Ghazi's head, the son of Ali said\nAbbas, loyalty itself kisses your feet

arabic text: Jawade ye nauha hai shahen shahe wafa ka\nhar lavs ko ashko ki gata chum rahi hai
english translation text: O "Jawaad", this lament belongs to the King of Loyalty\nThe rhythm of tears kisses every word
